about: Scenes for tests/run.ps1 and tests/compare.py. A run is one launch of the game; a scene is a named set of shot times in a run. Times are seconds after the save menu opens (from: menu) or after the game first reads the pad (from: boot); multiples of 0.1. golden_times are extra frames captured only for the golden set, so a test frame can be matched with the closest golden frame. See docs/testing.md.
